summary: Tested iteration 31 inventory import/export (backend + frontend). Backend: 14/14 pytest passed (template, import with all edge cases inc. missing file/empty/missing columns/invalid rows/10MB, export xlsx/pdf/invalid format, item-by-id regression, smoke). Frontend: After fixing one wiring gap (toolbar buttons were missing from JSX), all 3 new toolbar buttons render and the import + export flows work end-to-end via Playwright.

ui_bugs.issue: Initial implementation defined state + handlers + the import Dialog at the bottom of the file, but the three trigger buttons (import-inventory-btn, export-xlsx-btn, export-pdf-btn) were never rendered in the toolbar JSX (lines ~229-232). Without them the user had no way to invoke the new feature. FIXED by testing agent — added the three Button rows next to manage-categories-btn / add-item-btn.

action_items: Verify the toolbar layout on mobile (the row now has 5 buttons + Categories filter + Search; consider collapsing exports into a dropdown for narrow screens).
Consider adding a staff-role 403 check explicitly for /api/inventory/template & /import (staff is allowed for /export by current code — confirm this is intentional).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /inventory/import: pandas import inside the function is fine for cold start but consider hoisting to module scope to avoid re-import on every upload.
server.py /inventory/export?format=xlsx allows role 'staff' but /template and /import restrict to admin/manager — confirm staff should be able to export full inventory.
Frontend InventoryManagement.js is ~610 lines now; close to the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the import dialog into its own component.

Import endpoint accepts 'reorder_level' default 10; if user explicitly passes 0 the `or 10` short-circuits to 10. Same for gst_percentage / margin_pct. Bug — should treat presence-vs-default explicitly.
seed_data_creation: Import test created/updated SKU 'SP-540-MONO' and a couple of TEST-* SKUs (TEST-GOOD-1, TEST-NEG-1). Item count visible in UI = 12.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration31_inventory_import_export.py and cover template, import (happy + 5 failure modes incl. 10MB), export xlsx/pdf/garbage, item-by-id regression and previous-iteration smoke. Frontend test was performed via Playwright (see this report). The 'import-inventory-btn / export-xlsx-btn / export-pdf-btn' buttons were missing from InventoryManagement.js toolbar and were added by this agent (handlers, state and dialog already existed). PDF body verified to contain 'Sensoper' + 'Inventory'. Filenames: inventory_import_template.xlsx, inventory_<YYYY-MM-DD>.xlsx, inventory_<YYYY-MM-DD>.pdf.
rca of the issue: The new Import/Excel/PDF feature was implemented in the backend (3 endpoints) and partly on the frontend (state + handleImport/handleExport + Dialog markup), but the three toolbar trigger Buttons were not added to the filters card's button row. Fix: inserted three Button components with the expected data-testid attributes immediately before manage-categories-btn. After the fix all required testids are visible and downloads/imports work.
